description: Pick a focus area and duration to get an ordered stretching routine with timed steps and instructions.

faqs.a: Hold static stretches 20–30 seconds per side and never bounce. Stretch to mild tension, never sharp pain.
faqs.q: How long should I hold each stretch?

faqs.a: Yes — the routine scales its steps to fill the 5, 10, or 15 minutes you choose.
Static stretching is best after activity or as a standalone session; use dynamic movement before intense exercise.

howto: Choose a focus area: neck, back, legs, or full body.
Follow the ordered steps, one timed stretch at a time.
title: Stretch Routine Generator
